exploratory_intents.hypothesis: The buildup_action segment at source 4706.45-4718.45 may be a redundant bridge between the deficit scoreboard and the equalizer goal; removing it could tighten pacing without losing essential game-state information since the scoreboard already establishes the deficit and the equalizer goal action carries the turn.
exploratory_intents.expected_effect: Tighter development-to-turn transition; removes a potentially dispensable non-goal bridge segment and reduces the perceived source-time jump between setup and equalizer.
